title: Citrusy Beef Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Vietnamese-inspired stir fry made with beef, noodles, and a hint of citrus.

ingredients.name: Citrusy Sauce
ingredients.notes: mix of soy sauce, lime juice, and honey

ingredients.name: Vegetables
ingredients.notes: bell peppers, onions, and snow peas

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the noodles to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Return the beef to the skillet and pour in the citrusy sauce.
Stir everything together and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Optional: add kicked chili flakes to taste for an extra kick.
